meta.title: Radar on Intschool_Skill_v1.1
meta.description: Build a one-page IntSchool radar report card for any subject or role: course-level radar with task drill-down, weekly attribution and forecast, Top/Bottom/Missing tasks, a six-student triage queue, a class × task-type heat map, communication coverage, bilingual parent drafts (never sent), a printable student self-check, and a parent view without peer comparison. Includes the read-only collector, renderer, illustrated guide and configurable defaults; MIT licensed so colleagues can adapt and re-share.
